+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: Stop recording embedding input text in the transcript; keep the embedding event metadata-only
+---
+## What
+
+`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedEmbedder.swift:30-51`, `RoutedModel.embed(texts:)` (the `RoutedEmbedder` surface), appends one `TranscriptEvent` of kind `.embedding` per call. The event does NOT carry the vectors. It carries the **input texts** as the event body: line 44, `text: texts.joined(separator: "\n")`. At `RecordingLevel.full` (the default that `GatingRecorder` forwards verbatim, `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/GatingRecorder.swift:74-77`) every string a caller embeds is copied into `transcript.jsonl`.
+
+This is waste for two reasons:
+
+1. **Bloat.** Embedding is a bulk operation (a corpus of chunks), and nothing reads the copied text back. `Kind.embedding` is not an entry kind (`TranscriptEvent.swift:50`, `isEntryKind == false`), `TranscriptEntryMapper` refuses it (`TranscriptEntryMapper.swift:167`), and `TranscriptTree.effectiveEntryEvents` drops it (`TranscriptTreeTests.swift:834`). The body is dead weight in a real transcript.
+2. **Cost on the hot path.** `texts.joined(separator: "\n")` builds one string the size of the whole batch on every call, then the redact hook runs over it, then the sink serializes it. None of that is needed for what the event is for: provenance and timing (`routerId`, `slot`, `model`, `ms`).
+
+Change `embed(texts:)` so the event is metadata-only, always, regardless of `RecordingLevel`:
+
+- In `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedEmbedder.swift` remove the `text:` argument (and the comment at lines 42-43) from the `TranscriptEvent.Partial` built at lines 36-46; keep `routerId`, `sessionId`, `slot: .embedding`, `model: chosen`, `kind: .embedding`, `ms`.
+- Update the doc comments at lines 3-10 and 15-29 so they state: the event records provenance and duration only; the inputs and the vectors are never recorded; the recording level and redact hook still decide whether the event is forwarded at all (`.off` drops it).
+- Keep the `.embedding` `Kind`, the one-event-per-call contract, the best-effort swallow, and the `to: nil` root placement unchanged. Do not touch `GatingRecorder` or `TranscriptEvent`.
+
+Subtasks:
+
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/MergedAndRedactionTests.swift:665-667` (`redactWiredThroughRouter`): the embedding event now has `text == nil` at `.full` with a redact hook; the prompt assertion at line 664 is unchanged. Rename the comment at line 665 accordingly. Add `#expect(event.text == nil)` and `#expect(event.ms != nil)` to `ProfileLifecycleTests.embedRecordsOneEmbeddingEvent` (`Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ProfileLifecycleTests.swift:246-266`), which runs at the default `.full` level with no redact hook. Both fail before the change.
+- [ ] Remove the `text:` body from the `Partial` in `RoutedEmbedder.swift` and update the two doc comments.
+- [ ] Clean build with zero warnings, full `swift test` green.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `grep -n "joined" Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedEmbedder.swift` returns no match; `grep -n "text:" Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedEmbedder.swift` returns no match.
+- [ ] After `profile.embedding.embed(texts: ["a", "b"])` on a router at `RecordingLevel.full` with no redact hook, the recorded event has `kind == .embedding`, `slot == .embedding`, `model == profile.embedding.chosen`, `ms != nil`, and `text == nil`.
+- [ ] After the same call on a router at `.full` with a redact hook, the recorded embedding event has `text == nil` (the hook has nothing to transform) and the session prompt event is still redacted (`"a *** prompt"`).
+- [ ] `MergedAndRedactionTests.metadataOnlyWiredThroughRouter` (line 601) still passes unchanged: an embedding event is still recorded at `.metadataOnly`.
+- [ ] `ToolSharedProfileTests.embedToolCallRecordsAnEvent` (`ToolSharedProfileTests.swift:229-252`) and `TranscriptTreeTests` (lines 815-836) pass unchanged.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/MergedAndRedactionTests.swift` `redactWiredThroughRouter` (line 634): replace `#expect(embedding.text == "another ***")` with `#expect(embedding.text == nil)`.
+- [ ] Extend `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ProfileLifecycleTests.swift` `embedRecordsOneEmbeddingEvent` (line 246) with `#expect(event.text == nil)` and `#expect(event.ms != nil)`.
+- [ ] Run `swift build 2>&1` — expected: exit 0, zero warnings (clean build; a cache-hit build hides warnings).
+- [ ] Run `swift test` — expected: all tests pass. Do not use a display-name `--filter`; it matches nothing and exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+#tech-debt #performance #transcript
\ No newline at end of file
